question: How are Rāmagayā and the Rāma offering spatially located at the site?
premises: Rāmagayā is located at the head-side.
The Rāma offering is located in the south.
The verse distinguishes these two locations.
inference: Rāmagayā is at the head-side while the Rāma offering is in the south.
plain_english: Rāmagayā is at the head-side, and the Rāma offering is in the south.
